summary: In the United States, Atenolol has a boxed warning, which is the strongest type of safety warning, for heart harm [3]. An official agency warning also notes that the drug can make heart failure worse by weakening the heart muscle's ability to pump blood [7]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this medicine low scores for both liver and heart risk [M]. Additionally, one clinical study involving the drug was stopped early by its safety monitoring board [10].
